extDescription.message: Adds a map view with all geotagged photos to the Synology Photos web interface.

diagText.message: – please copy this text and pass it on so the extension can be adjusted.

diagHint.message: This information helps to adjust the extension. Contains file names, but no passwords or tokens.

errApiMissing.message: API not found – is Synology Photos installed?

errSessionExpired.message: Session expired – please sign in again.

errSessionReplaced.message: Session was ended by another login.

errToken.message: Session/token invalid – reload the page (F5) and try again.

statusIncomplete.message: Incomplete: stopped after $scanned$ photos ($error$). $located$ with location shown – “Reload” tries again.

statusNone.message: No photos with GPS data found ($scanned$ checked).

statusCached.message: $located$ photos with location · as of $date$ (cache) – “Reload” fetches current data

popupActive.message: Active – the “Map” button appears at the bottom right in Synology Photos.

popupInactive.message: Not enabled for this address yet.

popupNoPage.message: Open Synology Photos in this tab first, then click the extension again.

popupReloadFirst.message: The page doesn’t know the extension yet – please reload it once (F5).

popupDisabled.message: Disabled. Reload the page to remove the button.

cacheCleared.message: Cache cleared. Everything will be loaded from the NAS again next time.

cacheClearFailed.message: The cache could not be cleared.

cacheClearPending.message: The cache will be cleared once the map is closed or the tab is reloaded.
